Name: Kenneth's Prism Potions
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Prism Potions[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]10 solid-color prism potions for Kenneth's Potion Shop. Rose, sunlight, and crystal looks, one color per bottle.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]10 potions in Shop3, all with that clean, one-color feel. Some are warm and bright, some are cool and calm, and a few are the kind you save for a long day. Prism potions are in there, in rose, sunlight, crystal, void, amethyst, azure, emerald, sunset, tidal, and crimson looks.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop3 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Potion Shop - Shop3[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You buy with gold, no bars or gems needed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Potion Shop, Shop3.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Potion Shop - you need this so Shop3 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Potion Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop3.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other potions from Kenneth's Potion Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
